title: On Reaching the station an hour early
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：reach　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reach 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the keeper ① reached the station an hour early twice over, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② reaches the station an hour early year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ reach the station an hour early at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ reached the station an hour early before — a line in the calendar for January 1945 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reaching the station an hour early twice over, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ reach the top shelf without a chair year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Reach the top shelf without a chair at once and never mention it again.

By 1958 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ reaches the top shelf without a chair twice over every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ reached the station an hour early again when nobody else would.

⑩ To reach the station an hour early, my mother said in 1963, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody reaches the station an hour early year after year again and somebody must reach the station an hour early twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 到达（一般过去式 reached the station an hour early：1951 年守夜人头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 到达（一般现在 reaches the station an hour early：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 到达（不定式 to reach the station an hour early：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 到达（过去完成时 had reached the station an hour early：1945 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 到达（动名词 reaching the station an hour early 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 够到（reach the top shelf without a chair：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去够到不登椅子就够到架子顶层）
G. v. 够到（reach the top shelf without a chair：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 到达（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 reaches the top shelf without a chair，而母亲又一次 reached the station an hour early）

answers.why: reach 意为“到达”，1951 年守夜人来回两遍到达提前一个钟头到了车站，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 reached。
reach 意为“到达”，自那以后守夜人年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reaches。
reach 意为“到达”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯到达提前一个钟头到了车站”，此处为不定式 to reach the station an hour early。
reach 意为“到达”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1958 年之前就有人到达过，故用过去完成时 had reached。
reach 意为“到达”，守夜人说“到达提前一个钟头到了车站这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reaching the station an hour early 作主语。
reach 意为“够到”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去够到不登椅子就够到架子顶层”，should ever 之后用原形 reach the top shelf without a chair。
reach 意为“够到”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻够到不登椅子就够到架子顶层（reach the top shelf without a chair at once），以后再也不要提起。
reach 意为“到达”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例够到不登椅子就够到架子顶层，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reaches。
reach 意为“到达”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍到达提前一个钟头到了车站，用一般过去式 reached 叙述。
reach 意为“到达”，结尾那句是母亲 1963 年的话：要到达提前一个钟头到了车站，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

守夜人说过，来回两遍到达提前一个钟头到了车站这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（reaching the station an hour early 作主语）

Three years on, the keeper still reaches the station an hour early year after year without being asked.

Somebody had reached the station an hour early long before 1958, and the line in the calendar for January proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 reach 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the keeper reached the station an hour early twice over, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper reaches the station an hour early year after year whenever the tower asks.
Reaching the station an hour early twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever reach the top shelf without a chair year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower reaches the top shelf without a chair twice over every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother reached the station an hour early again, and the tower remembered that half.
